full_name: Fushcia-Ann Hoover | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2023–2024 Social Sciences Radcliffe-Salata Climate Justice Fellow UNC Charlotte
bio: Fushcia-Ann Hoover is an interdisciplinary researcher specializing in socio-ecological systems, and her work explores the impacts of green infrastructure planning in the context of environmental racism, justice, and Black ecologies.
